description: Replacement-family member: Adapt fixed at keyword-high, Nebulento (fuzzy string matching over templates) fills the template-medium slot.
notes: FAMILY: tmpl-slot 4-way — mycroft-classic (adapt-high -> padatious-medium) is the shared baseline; siblings are tmpl-slot-nebulento (this file), tmpl-slot-linhafina, tmpl-slot-jurebes, each swapping only the template-medium engine with adapt-high held fixed. There is no separate tmpl-slot-padatious fighter: that config is identical to mycroft-classic, and per the 1-fighter-per-config rule mycroft-classic itself serves as the 'template engine = padatious' cell of this grid rather than duplicating the same pipeline under a second competitor_id. This sibling swaps in Nebulento (fuzzy edit-distance-style template matching, tolerant of typos/ASR noise) as the backup, with adapt-high held fixed. Note this pipeline shape (adapt-high -> nebulento-medium -> [no third stage]) is a strict 2-stage subset of nebulapt.json's 3-stage adapt-high -> nebulento-medium -> adapt-medium; kept as a separate, deliberately shorter fighter because the family's isolation question is 'first successful replacement per engine' with no retry stage, whereas nebulapt additionally tests whether an adapt-medium retry recovers more on top of the pair — a different, additive hypothesis.
